heard: Rooted deep in the soil of Judah, the branch of Jeremiel grew. As Ron's firstborn led the way, Ram and Bona in their day. Orn and Ozem stood beside, Hijah walking with pride. Another wife named Adara, mother of Onam in the earth Shemay and Jada were born from Onam's light in the dawn Shemay's sons were Nadab and Abishur Abishur's wife bore the food
